_note: One Shot rounds (the 'Test mules' tab of the Database shows them too). Question image: Res/oneshot/<id>/1.webp (the test mule); answer image: Res/oneshot/<id>/2.webp (the real car). 'aliases' are extra accepted answers. 'hints' are three optional text hints the player can open one by one; empty ones stay hidden. 'decoys' only feed the autocomplete.

rounds.name: BMW X5 (E53)
rounds.fact: BMW's first SUV, which it called a Sports Activity Vehicle, developed while BMW owned Land Rover.
hints: developed while BMW owned Land Rover.

rounds.name: Aston Martin DBX
rounds.fact: Aston Martin's first SUV, built in a new factory in St Athan, Wales.
hints: Brand right know has close "connections" with Mercedes

rounds.name: Ferrari Enzo
rounds.fact: Named after the company's founder; early test mules wore modified Ferrari 348 bodies.

rounds.name: Land Rover Freelander
rounds.fact: Land Rover's first monocoque model, and for years Europe's best-selling 4x4.

rounds.name: Rolls-Royce Cullinan
rounds.fact: Rolls-Royce's first SUV, named after the largest gem-quality diamond ever found.
hints: From same brand as the test mule.

rounds.name: Jaguar XJ220
rounds.fact: Parts of its drivetrain were tested hidden inside a Ford Transit van.

rounds.name: Mercedes-Benz SLR McLaren
rounds.fact: Built by McLaren in Woking, with a front-mid V8 and side-exit exhausts.

rounds.name: Nissan GT-R (R35)
rounds.fact: Early test mules wore Infiniti G35 (Skyline V35) coupe bodies.
hints: 3.8L Twin-Turbo V6 and has Nismo version.
